subject: Renewal + Capacity Increase — redlines on MSA & order form
messages:
From: Tanya Reyes <tanya.reyes@edgewave.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: procure@edgewave.com, legal@edgewave.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + 30% capacity increase — initial request & redline asks

Markus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. EdgeWave is ready to move forward on a 24‑month renewal with a 30% capacity uplift (we've modeled traffic through Q4 FY28). Attached is our renewal request packet (includes procurement timeline and the internal PO cadence). Our legal team has highlighted three high‑impact items in the MSA and order form that need alignment before procurement can issue a PO:

- Term length: we prefer a 24‑month term with a 90‑day early‑exit notice (we can discuss amortization of credits)
- Indemnity & data residency: language to limit cross‑jurisdictional exposure and confirm EU data residency for a subset of workloads
- SLA credits & termination for convenience: we need clearer credit triggers and an explicit termination for convenience carveout for material changes

I've attached the EdgeWave_Renewal_Request_Sept2027.pdf and our high‑level MSA redline summary. Procurement is on a tight timeline — target signature by end of next week if we can agree commercial/legal. Can you confirm whether Redwood is comfortable with the 24‑month term and whether you can accept the proposed residency carve (or suggest an equivalent control)?

Best,
Tanya Reyes
Head of Platform Partnerships
EdgeWave

Attachment: EdgeWave_Renewal_Request_Sept2027.pdf (summary + timeline)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Tanya Reyes <tanya.reyes@edgewave.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + 30% capacity increase — initial request & redline asks

Tanya — thanks for the packet and for the clear ask. Excited to keep EdgeWave on Redwood and support the uplift. Quick read: 24 months is generally fine but we need to align on the SLA/credits and the termination language. I attached our current OrderForm draft (Redwood_OrderForm_v4.docx) to show billing cadence and surge handling.

Next steps I propose:
- Internal legal + pricing to review EdgeWave_MSA_redlines and propose counter language (looping in Lauren + Priyom).
- Commercial compromise on termination for convenience — we can offer a pro‑rata refund less committed capacity usage for early exits; will need concrete examples to model impact.
- Data residency: we can designate an EU tenant for the subset of workflows and commit via Exhibit E; need product ops confirmation on timelines (we can provide an ETA).

I'll take point on the commercial modeling. Lauren/Priyom — can you review EdgeWave's highlighted PDF and give proposed redline responses by EOD Thu? Jordan — can you prepare a quick pricing sensitivity (3 scenarios: baseline, +15%, +30%) so procurement can see economics?

Thanks —
Markus Klein
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_OrderForm_v4.docx

From: EdgeWave Legal <legal@edgewave.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, Tanya Reyes <tanya.reyes@edgewave.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + 30% capacity increase — initial request & redline asks

Markus/Tanya — attaching our marked MSA pages (EdgeWave_MSA_redlines.pdf). Highlights:

1) Indemnity: narrow to third‑party IP claims; remove catch‑all broad indemnities.
2) Termination for convenience: EdgeWave requests a 60‑day termination for convenience right with defined wind‑down assistance and data export obligations.
3) Data residency & audit: request right to annual audit for the EU tenant and a written commitment to keep data within EU regions for specified projects.

We are flexible on the credit math as long as the governance is clear. Procurement will hold an internal approval meeting next Tue — if we have a counter by COB Mon, they can greenlight the PO issuance.

Regards,
EdgeWave Legal

Attachment: EdgeWave_MSA_redlines.pdf

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 10:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: EdgeWave MSA redlines — need quick legal + finance posture

Forwarding EdgeWave's redlines. Lauren/Priyom — urgent ask: procurement will likely sign the PO if we can ship a reasonable counter by Monday morning. Key priorities below (please call out which items are firm 'no' vs negotiable):

- Term: EdgeWave wants a 24‑month term w/ 60‑90 day termination for convenience. Commercially OK; legal — how do we protect committed capacity economics?
- Indemnity: request to narrow scope. Can we restrict indemnity to IP, gross negligence, and willful misconduct?
- Data residency: can product ops commit to an EU tenant with SOC2 controls within a 6‑week window? If not, propose a migration schedule + temporary safeguards.
- Audit rights: propose replacing annual in‑person audit with an agreed evidence package + remote audit at cost.

Priyom — can you run a quick sensitivity on the financial exposure if we accept a 60‑day TFC (assume 30% uplift, month‑to‑month billing after termination)? Jordan — pls drop me the pricing scenarios Markus asked for into the shared Drive link below.

Thanks — on a tight cadence.

--
Markus

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeWave MSA redlines — need quick legal + finance posture

Markus — quick notes after review:

- Indemnity: agree to narrow to third‑party IP claims and liability for Redwood's negligence/willful misconduct. Push back on any broad product‑level indemnities.
- Termination for convenience: recommend countering with a 90‑day notice OR a 60‑day notice plus minimum burn fee equal to 25% of committed monthly capacity for the notice period to protect committed economics.
- Data residency & audit: product cannot guarantee a fully segregated EU tenant within 6 weeks. Suggest a formal Exhibit E that commits to a staged delivery: Phase 1 (EU storage + access controls within 8 weeks), Phase 2 (tenant segregation within 16 weeks). For audit, accept remote evidence package + on‑site at Redwood's discretion (with cost recovery).

I'll prepare a redline PDF with the recommended language (Redwood_MSA_response_redline.pdf) and propose the OrderForm updates to reflect the pro‑rata/remediation language. Priyom — if you can confirm the exposure numbers we discussed, I'll finalize the legal posture.

—Lauren
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Tanya Reyes <tanya.reyes@edgewave.com>, EdgeWave Procurement <procure@edgewave.com>, EdgeWave Legal <legal@edgewave.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 14:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity Increase — proposed compromise and next steps

Tanya — thanks for the patience. Attached are our proposed redlines and a clean OrderForm (OrderForm_EdgeWave_vFinal.xlsx). Summary of the compromise: 

- Term: 24 months with a 60‑day termination for convenience window plus a minimum burn protection equal to 25% of committed monthly capacity applied pro‑rata for the notice period.
- Indemnity: narrowed to third‑party IP claims and Redwood's gross negligence/willful misconduct.
- Data residency: we commit to Exhibit E delivery plan — EU storage & access controls in 8 weeks, tenant segregation in 16 weeks. Audit via remote evidence package; on‑site at cost.
- SLA credits: clarified credit triggers and a maximum quarterly cap aligned to committed spend.

If that looks acceptable, please confirm and we'll route for DocuSign. If procurement needs model numbers, Jordan & Priyom have uploaded the scenario workbook into the HubSpot deal and shared Drive (see links).

Best,
Markus Klein
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_response_redline.pdf; OrderForm_EdgeWave_vFinal.xlsx
